_comment: The WHO SMART Immunizations artefact index — the SECOND ingested IG, and the one that tested whether the pipeline generalises. Declared exactly as `smart-trust` is on main today, MINUS a `docs` graph: the owner ruled on 2026-09-21 that generated HTML is not wanted ('i dont want the. /html generated... just the calculated versions, dependcies and such the AST end'), so this instance ships the index and its DAK surface and renders nothing. PROVISIONAL BY DESIGN: the owner has also ruled that a per-IG harness should not exist at all ('there does not neeed to be smart-trust harness, b/c no new funcionality'), with the DAK/IG pipeline belonging in an IG base and the output landing in a `smart-guideline` page under a new `smart-base` harness (bean nsbb). This declaration keeps the repository CONSISTENT rather than half-migrated while that restructure is decided; it is not an argument that the instance should persist.
name: smart-immunizations
description: WHO SMART Immunizations (smart.who.int.immunizations) v0.2.0, FHIR 4.0.1 — the published IG's artefact index, reconstructed: 748 artefacts known, 200 materialized.

directories.description: The reconstructed artefact index and the DAK API surface it points at. 40.6 MB of sidecars, materialised on the owner's explicit choice of 'everything' over the 11.3 MB schema+jsonld subset — 133x smart-trust's 332 KB, because this IG publishes 198 schemas and 188 display files against smart-trust's 19 and 14. `index.json` carries a `provenance` block naming the published file every field came out of, and `dakUnbound` records any sidecar an enumeration listed that bound to no artefact.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Copies of upstream IG artefacts, and GENERATED -- `ingest-ig-artifacts.ts` rewrites this index, a person does not edit it. Read-only is about the second: a hand edit here silently changes what this repository claims upstream published, and `check:materialized-fixity` is what catches one that happened.

directories.description: The reader-facing pages, and the landing page `/smart-immunizations/` serves. Generated by `smart-immunizations:pages` (`fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts --summary`) from `fhir-artifact-index/index.json`: the instance's own harness section, then every artefact with its canonical URL, published representations and sidecars. The index page declares itself the `fhir-artifact-index` viewer (`rendered-by: ig-pages`). WHY: until stage C of #1767 this IG's artefact index had no published viewer at all. NOTHING HERE IS AUTHORED; `smart-immunizations:pages:check` is the gate.
directories._comment_composed: Rendered THROUGH just-the-docs, as smart-trust's and smart-base's are.

directories.description: What auditing THIS instance produced, committed so a consumer can tell "never audited" from "audited clean" — a printed verdict cannot, which is why every QA verdict here is a sidecar. TWO kinds live here and the files declare which they are via $schema: kg-qa/v1, one per audited subject, in a tree mirroring the subject’s own path, and ONE kg-qa-manifest/v1 recording the auditor’s identity for all of them. The manifest moved here from skills/ on 2026-09-27: kg-audit.ts writes it unconditionally, so its old home created a skills/ directory holding no skills in every instance that has none. At declaration time that is 1 file across scenarios (1). No qa-results/v1 and no witnesses: this instance runs no document build and no witness-producing computation, and declaring kinds it does not hold would be an over-claim. dependents: reproduce, because a dependent audits its OWN graph — these verdicts are about this instance’s nodes, and inheriting them would attribute one instance’s findings to another. Declared WITH its files in one commit, per bean dh4f: a declared-but-absent directory makes a consumer scan nothing and report a clean run over it.

_needs_comment: REPOINTED 2026-09-22 (issue #975) from `folio-assistant-core` to `smart-ig`. THIS IS WHAT MAKES `nsbb`'s RULING TRUE IN THE DECLARATIONS rather than only in prose: there is no per-IG harness, so `smart-immunizations` is an INSTANCE OF `smart-ig` rather than a harness of its own. `smart-immunizations`'s declaration already called its own harness status 'PROVISIONAL BY DESIGN' pending this restructure. `needs` governs the LAYER ORDER: `dependency-order.ts` topologically sorts on it and `harness-tiles.ts` builds the LHS navbar spine from it. It does NOT compose the skill or content overlay -- that is `dependencies.folioAssistant` in `<name>.config.json`, walked recursively by `resolveSkillDirs`, and the two are different mechanisms with different files. MEASURED 2026-09-22 rather than assumed, after this comment first claimed otherwise: with `needs` set correctly, `resolveSkillDirs` still returns each instance's OWN skills and nothing from the layer below. No `smart-*` instance declares config dependencies at all, so no overlay composes anywhere in this stack -- bean recorded, not fixed here.
